body.estimand_functional: \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}=\min_{E_{\mathrm{sw}}:\,\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q,E_{\mathrm{sw}};G)=1}\operatorname{Cost}(E_{\mathrm{sw}}),\quad\min\varnothing=+\infty\), where \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\) is the operational predicate; the separate ordinary full-kernel result uses \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{batch}}\).

sampling_model.design: The structural input fixes the action catalogue and supplies a charged source oracle.  Each distinct legal protocol is queried and paid for once; any number of positive slices and target branches may reuse its cached law.  Sparse records carry one \(q_M\)-bit concrete branch index apiece, while an ordinary full-kernel batch shares one purchased protocol set across all translated cells.
sampling_model.units: Each SELECT draws a fresh independent unit from the target population, and all potential responses for that unit are generated by one recursive finite-discrete SCM compatible with \(G\).
sampling_model.treatment: RAND actions replace a node mechanism for all affected children, while CTF-RAND actions fix the value delivered to their catalogued child subset without erasing the unit's natural decision.
sampling_model.overlap: Positivity is local to computation: only an event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\) actually used as a conditioning denominator must have positive mass in the exact returned support table.  Unused cells may be zero.  This condition makes the displayed conditional well defined but supplies no semantic CTFIDU+ completeness theorem.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None is claimed.  Complete-law handles remain symbolic, exact support payloads are oracle replies charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\), and neither scalar functional evaluation nor empirical estimation is part of the result.

CTF-REALIZE decides physical realizability of an explicit action sequence, not priced protocol-cover optimization.
The ICML paper establishes ordinary minimum-cost intervention design and NP-completeness, not the physical batch translation.
Theorem 3 gives the MWHS reduction and Corollary 2 gives the logarithmic inapproximability threshold for the ordinary full-kernel problem.
Ordinary minimum-cost proxy design admits weighted Max-SAT and integer-programming formulations.

body.tldr: Operational acceptance of a finite generic source collection is equivalent to one sparse, singleton-index source record per concrete assignment/equality branch.  This induces an exact weighted set-cover problem on legal protocols: the complete incidence is built with at most \(2^{|\mathcal A|}\) source-oracle queries, exact optimization takes \(2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+\min\{M,2^{|\mathcal A|}\})}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}}+N_{\mathcal O})\) time, and weighted greedy gives \(H_M\) after incidence enumeration.  The certificate bound uses \(M\lceil\log_2(M+1)\rceil\) ownership bits plus explicit framing.  Event-local positivity is required only for denominators actually used.  The ordinary Akbari--Etesami--Kiyavash comparison is an explicit all-cells batch with shared protocol charges, not a scalar-query reduction, and its hardness transfer is oracle-relative.  The separate \(H_k\) action-cover statement remains confined to the explicit one-action, protocolwise-legality, factorwise-no-synergy subclass.

project_justification.gap: Fixed-source counterfactual identification does not choose or price physical protocols, and its semantic completeness theorem is not established under the event-local positivity class used by the acquisition interface.  Ordinary Q[S] design concerns a full-kernel batch rather than one scalar counterfactual cell.
project_justification.niche: The missing object is an operational protocol-to-concrete-branch incidence whose witnesses retain positive measured-ancestry slices and whose costs are shared at the protocol level.
project_justification.fill: The project proves a sparse operational switching normal form, derives an exact weighted protocol-cover identity, gives exact dynamic-programming/protocol-subset optimization and an \(H_M\) greedy certificate, includes an exact sparse encoding bound, and supplies a typed shared-charge ordinary full-kernel batch equivalence with oracle-qualified hardness.

body.related_work: Raghavan and Bareinboim (2025) define the physical SELECT, RAND, CTF-RAND, and READ actions and provide the CTF-REALIZE legality test; they do not optimize shared acquisition cost.  Raghavan and Bareinboim (2026) analyze complete CTFIDU+ from a fixed input collection.  This note uses only the operational recursion and does not import semantic completeness to its weaker, event-local positivity class.  Correa, Lee, and Bareinboim (2021) motivate the single-world and counterfactual factorization boundary.  Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2025), Theorem 3 and Corollary 2, supply the ordinary MWHS reduction and logarithmic threshold.  The exact correspondence here is only with an explicitly defined all-cells SELECT--RAND--READ batch sharing protocol charges; because complete law/support replies can be exponentially large, the hardness transfer is oracle-relative.  The general physical incidence has an \(H_M\) weighted-greedy guarantee after exponential incidence enumeration, not a polynomial structural action-cover guarantee.  The distinct \(H_k\) action-cover corollary remains limited to the explicit one-action, protocolwise-legality, factorwise-no-synergy subclass.  Park and Lee (2026) provide the downstream counterfactual bandit setting, not the acquisition theorem.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The branch count \(M\) can be exponential, and the complete protocol-to-branch incidence may itself require \(2^{O(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|)}\) work and exponentially long oracle support replies.  The \(H_M\) algorithm is polynomial only in this explicit incidence, not in the structural input alone.  Event-local positivity does not establish semantic CTFIDU+ completeness.  General semantic nonidentification, scalar-functional evaluation, conditional-query completeness, arbitrary partial-read completeness, compact lower certificates, mediator-depth FPT, and bounded-treewidth compilation are not proved.
body.honest_scope: The headline is exact operational optimization: sparse switching acceptance equals weighted cover of all concrete branches, with an explicit certificate bound, exact algorithm, infeasibility test, and \(H_M\) protocol-cover approximation after incidence construction.  Positivity is imposed only on used denominators and measured ancestry remains mandatory.  The ordinary result is a separate finite all-cells batch equivalence with shared charges and oracle-relative hardness; no batch-to-scalar reduction or standard explicit-input hardness statement follows.  The \(H_k\) action-cover result applies only to the explicit one-action, protocolwise-legality, factorwise-no-synergy subclass.  No global action-level approximation, semantic completeness extension, scalar identifying-functional output, numerical evaluation, or polynomial certificate claim is made.
body.interpretation: A protocol covers exactly the concrete target branches for which some positive measured slice and finite restriction transcript succeeds.  Acquiring protocols is therefore a weighted set cover on those branch sets.  The causal query remains the scalar interventional/counterfactual target; the cover objective is an observed-interface acquisition optimization whose relation to the query is established only through the operational acceptance equivalence.
